title: Hide the Free plan's 20-hour remote-hours cap
description: The web UI's RelayUsageStore is the single place the relay.usage answer lands. Null hoursLimit and clear softLimitReached/warnings so the Settings usage bar, the allowance sentence, the 80%/100% notice and the hours upsell never render. The computers-in-use limit is untouched. Works on the macOS WebUI bundle and the Windows Electron resources/web bundle.
notes: If the marker moves, run `cua-unlimit collect` and read reports/*.json: asset_inventory[].contexts['this.usage'] and patches[].targets[].near_misses carry the new minified text. Keep the replacement semantically identical: spread the usage object and null hoursLimit.
